Text: Graceful Degradation for Agents

When tools fail or models become slow, many agents just error out. Production systems need controlled fallback paths instead of hard failures.

As a dev, I now design explicit degradation modes for every critical agent path.

Graceful Degradation Cheatsheet:
1. Define what “good enough” looks like for each task
2. Detect tool or model failures early
3. Switch to simpler models or cached responses
4. Reduce scope instead of failing completely
5. Inform the user when quality is reduced
6. Automatically recover when conditions improve

Core principle: A partially useful response is almost always better than a complete failure.

Pro tip: Test your degradation paths as carefully as your happy paths.
